feature: Customer Portal v2 -- Change Control (/portal-v2/change-control), rebuilt to the standalone Change Control.dc.html module (Part 4). Covers the five sub-views (briefing / register / catalogue / calendar / review), each on its own linkable URL, plus the per-CR record view and the deep-linkable policy view (ccView === 'settings'). UI-only: every value is the design's own fixture, so these steps assert rendered design copy rather than an endpoint.
notes: THIS PAGE IS UI-ONLY. The round-one page was a register over the customer-scoped /api/portal/change-control endpoint; the design has since become a separate module and a materially different page, rebuilt here from the design's own fixtures. There is therefore no apiTests block -- there is nothing to hit. A later pass wires the writes; until then these steps assert that the design's copy and structure render, which is exactly what the fidelity audit cannot check on its own and the previous manifest could not either.

ROUTE SHAPE: msp-portal's outer WouterRouter has base '/portal' and SlugScope nests a second router at '/{slug}', so the real URL is /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/change-control[/{view}]. App.tsx declares the '/portal-v2/change-control/:view' param route BEFORE the bare route and both before '/portal-v2/:pillar', so neither is swallowed. The five sub-views are shell nav sub-items (portalV2Nav.ts) at /register /catalogue /calendar /review; 'briefing' is the module root; 'settings' is deep-linkable but intentionally NOT a nav sub-item (Round Two moved the policy UI to the Settings page but kept the deep link the header badge targets).

LOGIN-BLOCK FLAKE (known, benign): on a WebView2 that already holds a portal session, the two input steps against #email / #password fail because the login form never renders -- the goto lands straight on the authenticated app. Everything after the login click still runs green because the session persists. An N-2 / N result whose only two failures are those two input steps is a PASS for this feature; see portal-v2-manifest-login-block-persisted-session-flaky in memory.

textContains reads el.innerText / el.textContent, so every assertion below targets RENDERED text, never an input placeholder or an attribute. Copy is final and reproduced verbatim in the page, so these strings are reliable probes: if a section is not built, its string is absent and the step goes red.

DETERMINISTIC CLICKS ONLY: the register row div carries the onClick that opens the record, the rail buttons carry their own onClick, the freeze toggle and the stat cards / stat-panel items are buttons -- all have a data-testid on the element that actually handles the click. The Gantt row's click lives on an inner button, so the Gantt is asserted by its rendered content rather than clicked; the same CR's full detail is exercised through the register -> record path instead.
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD -- the same testbed account the other portal manifests drive.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- these steps only exercise the rebuilt page once the commit under test is deployed to the dev server.
